_what: Where a workflow says when it fires: every workflow is a candidate branch of the one tree, and its own row holds its conditions in `field` (JSON text on a row, a list in a recipe). Each condition is { label, condition: { fields, tree }, made_by, state, evidence }: the label is the condition in words, the condition is the same {fields, tree} tool:filter-rows-by-rules takes, evaluated over one seed part, made_by says who wrote it (fires_when: moved from the old branch list, ai-judgment: written back by a run, the person). tool:choose-the-workflows-that-fire reads the person's workflow rows (arrivals/recipe-row-types.json) and the recipes this Workshop installs; a person's own row wins, and when it holds no conditions the catalog row's are used. A condition whose state is one of `off_states` chooses nothing and stays on the row with its reasons. Which workflows exist is never listed here: adding a workflow, or installing a kit, adds a candidate.
label: Fires when (JSON list of conditions)
